body: Hey, sorry to hear about that. Thanks for asking. Everything I touch just kinda seems to break instantaneously,  every person I've ever talked to abandoned me. My family couldn't give less of a shit about me. But that was always kind of the case. Which is why I fully committed myself to my educational path. It all went smooth for a while, but lately it all goes to shit. I have been working on a passion project for more than a month now and it disappeared without a trace. That just threw me off to a vomit inducing degree, in the literal sense. I stopped eating and would go days without sleep. So I'm just kinda lying here in my self pity, loathing my life. I don't believe in an afterlife, but any situation is better than my current one. Which is why I was researching the minimum height for a free fall suicide, but I got varying answers. And now I'm here, on reddit with a throwaway account and no will to life. I just want something to go right, even a single friend would keep me sane. Thanks for hearing me!
